subject.title: fix(slack): include canonical session transcript in prompt context (extends #95390)

question: Should Slack channel and thread wakes intentionally supplement the existing inbound transport history with up to ten canonical turns from the same resolved session?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused and evidence-backed, but it deliberately changes what historical session content becomes prompt-visible for room and thread wakes; this boundary is a maintainer-owned session-context decision rather than a test-only question.

options.title: Accept the bounded transcript merge
options.body: Merge the PR with its existing session-key, control-command, and history-limit safeguards so Slack wake context survives cache eviction and gateway restart.

options.title: Narrow the session-context policy
options.body: Keep the PR open while Slack owners specify a narrower room/thread scope or deduplication policy before accepting canonical transcript content in room prompts.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded transcript merge
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with its existing session-key, control-command, and history-limit safeguards so Slack wake context survives cache eviction and gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Slack routing work owns the workspace-qualified session identity that this prompt-context change must preserve.
